question: Does locally propagated Boolean influence proxy routing of observed errors improve structural learning over error-agnostic and correct-output routing, under fixed capacity/information/forward budgets?
hypothesis: Error-routed rewiring gains at least4 correct labels over EACH of original_single,uniform_matched,correct_routed, with observed fit at least746/768,zero initially correct facts lost and no per-task capacity ceiling violation. Reaching752 closes the original10-error gap but is secondary; missing any primary threshold is NEGATIVE.

mechanism.inference: Unchanged6NAND sites,13 one-hot-or-empty afferent/output rows,75binary coordinates,output exactly onehot;5old-valid protection bits;external replay six3bit-input/1bit-label examples=24bits
mechanism.packed_forward: Reuse WSP26 exact packed NAND semantics,adding a current-forward activation trace; each trial evaluates committed and proposed circuits on all6examples. No source catalog or symbolic synthesis.
mechanism.backward_influence: Output-source sensitivity starts as all6lanes. Walk six gates in reverse: sensitivity of gate-afferentA is gate-output sensitivity AND current activation of afferentB; conversely forB. Propagate these masks to the existing selected source by bitwise OR. Row12(output selector) has all6lanes sensitivity. Eligibility for row is nonempty intersection of its sensitivity with feedback lanes. No loss-gradient descent; exact Boolean sensitivity is a supplied credit-routing rule. IMPORTANT: OR-combined reverse local sensitivities are only a proxy for total causal influence when paths reconverge. Local gate derivatives are exact,global row effects need not be. Preserve a constructed reconvergence negative and independently measure proxy false positives/negatives; do not require false global exactness or claim that the proxy establishes causal credit.
mechanism.selection: Fixed cyclic-first eligible row beginning at the original random row index, implemented by binary eligibility and first-win products. If no row eligible,all13 eligible. This cyclic policy is not claimed uniform among eligible rows. Even trials always use original random row/source exploration; odd routed trials use chosen row and auxiliary random source. All writes remain single-row.
mechanism.streams: Original WSP20 Random(seed) draws j,k,g,a,b exactly every trial; g,a,b remain unused for one-row updates. Separate Random(seed+27000) draws one source index for the selected row every trial in every arm,even when unused. Auxiliary variable-bound draws may diverge by arm; original stream stays unchanged.
mechanism.commit: Same numerical nonworsening six-example error gate AND zero protected-old errors. Direct masked one-hot row rewrite,not continuous weight-gradient optimization. Failed proposals never change committed weights.
mechanism.limits: Hand-designed local Boolean credit rule. Inactive hidden structure remains explored by original random even steps. It is not algorithm invention,arbitrary primitive discovery,unfamiliar transfer or complete training.
